title: 第21章 合作第22章 风来
content_zh:
“没有条件，就是希望由我你还有里克老板我们三方合作开发一款新型的动力系统！
这就是我要把里克老板喊过来的原因。”
吉恩说完对着里克点点头后接着说道，吉恩有技术但是没有渠道，没有人脉。
“不知道里克老板对于现今船只的动力有多少认知呢？”
吉恩看着里克说道。
带着询问的眼神。
“船只现今比较成熟的动力就是风帆借助风力，及人力划桨借助水流自身的力，还有就是魔法阵提供的额外动力！
我知道的就这几种了”
里克老板说道，他说的这几种都是比较实用并且被普及了的。
“今天说到的新型动力系统就是蒸汽机，不知道里克老板有没有注意过水烧开后水会顶起盖子的情况？”
吉恩看着里克问道。
“这个肯定有了，那这个什么蒸汽机跟这个水烧开有什么关联吗？”
里克问道，卡德也看着吉恩，他们两个无法将烧开水与船只的动力放到一块去。
“当然，我这个蒸汽机就是依靠水烧开后产生的力设计而成的！”
吉恩肯定道。
“吉恩爵士我们也没见到过实物，这个水烧开能产生推动船只的力吗？你也知道像昆特七号的那种大型船只需要很大的风帆才能使它动起来？”
里克心里还是有点不相信。
“这个没有关系，蒸汽机我这里就有一台制造完成的，而且今天我还不止这一个目的，你们跟我来。”
吉恩说完把他们引到后院一个小院子，这台蒸汽机被小七设计成了一个锤打的机器（只是简单的表现出蒸汽机的力）几人站好，吉恩用魔法点燃蒸汽机的燃烧室，随着温度的升高，活塞开始运动，转盘上的钢绳缓缓拉拽着金属锤头往上提升，然后突然一松锤头猛然落下，锤头砸在另一端的铁砧上，轰的一声，吓大家一跳，有了第一下马上就来了第二下，速度越来越快，最后以一个相对稳定的频率敲击着铁砧，过了会吉恩收去魔法，蒸汽机缓缓停止运行，里克卡德两人看呆了，浑然不觉得刚刚轰轰声吵闹！
“我…感觉我们好…像要改变…这个世界了！”

里克断断续续的说道，他无法相信一个简单的烧水竟然可以迸发如此强大的力！
那个水箱看起来也不大。
“不里克！
是这个世界将因我们而改变！”
卡德肯定两眼放光的说道！
“是的世界将因大家而改变，我的想法是我出设计图纸，你们两位找人负责制造，专利项目希望你们回希望之城后帮我去申请一个，有了这个蒸汽机我们就可以开展另一个想法了，这个想法才是跟里克老板真正相关的项目！”
吉恩笑道，里克一听马上转头看着他。
“吉恩爵士请说。”
里克说道。
“就是钢铁轮船的项目，因为我生活在帝国的斯凯格丝海港，我一直想改变我们的船只，让它变的更加坚固耐用速度更快装载量更大！
这么多年总算是有了初步的成果！
content_en:
"There are no conditions, I just hope that we, you and Boss Rick will cooperate to develop a new power system!
That's why I'm calling Boss Rick over here. "
After Gene finished speaking, he nodded to Rick and then said, Gene has skills but no channels or connections.
"I wonder how much Boss Rick knows about the power of today's ships?"
Gene said looking at Rick.
With a questioning look.
"The more mature power sources for ships today are sails using the wind, human oars using the power of the water itself, and the additional power provided by the magic array!
That’s all I know.”
Boss Rick said that the types he mentioned are relatively practical and popular.
"The new power system we talked about today is the steam engine. I wonder if Boss Rick has ever noticed that the water will lift up the lid after it is boiled?"
Gene asked looking at Rick.
"This must be there, but does this steam engine have anything to do with boiling water?"
Rick asked, and Card looked at Gene. The two of them couldn't put boiling water together with the power of the ship.
"Of course, my steam engine is designed to rely on the force generated by boiling water!"
Gene affirmed.
"Sir Jean, we have never seen a real thing. Can boiling water produce the force to propel a ship? Do you also know that a large ship like Quint 7 requires a large sail to move it?"
Rick still didn't believe it.
"It doesn't matter. I have a completed steam engine here, and I have more than one purpose today. You follow me."
After speaking, Jean led them to a small yard in the backyard. This steam engine was designed by Xiao Qi as a hammering machine (just to simply show the power of the steam engine). The few of them stood up, and Jean used magic to ignite the combustion chamber of the steam engine. As the temperature increased, the piston began to move. The steel rope on the turntable slowly pulled the metal hammer head upward, and then suddenly let go. The hammer head fell suddenly, and hit the anvil at the other end. There was a bang, which startled everyone. The first blow was followed immediately by the second blow, faster and faster, and finally it hit the anvil at a relatively stable frequency. After a while, Gene took away the magic, and the steam engine slowly stopped running. Rickard and Rickard were stunned, and they didn't realize the noise just now!
"I... feel like we... are going to change... the world!"
Rick said intermittently, he couldn't believe that a simple boiling water could unleash such a powerful force!
That water tank doesn't look big either.
“No Rick!
It is this world that will change because of us! "
Card must have said with his eyes shining!
"Yes, the world will change because of everyone. My idea is that I will produce the design drawings, and you two will find someone to be responsible for manufacturing. For the patent project, I hope you will help me apply for one after you return to the City of Hope. With this steam engine, we can start another idea. This idea is the project that is really relevant to Boss Rick!"
Gene smiled, and Rick immediately turned to look at him.
"Sir Jean, please speak."
Rick said.
"It's the steel ship project. Because I live in the Skaggs seaport of the Empire, I have always wanted to change our ships to make them stronger, more durable, faster, faster and larger in load capacity!
After so many years, we finally have some initial results!
